info.name: EAAC Mobile API
info.description:
# EAAC Mobile API

Every endpoint the EAAC mobile app calls on the Moodle 5.2 backend, ordered the way a user meets them: sign-in → browse → learn → pay → account.

## Three transports

| Transport | URL | Auth | Errors |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Moodle web service** (most calls) | `{{baseUrl}}/webservice/rest/server.php?wsfunction=…&moodlewsrestformat=json` | `wstoken` | HTTP 200 with `{"exception","errorcode","message"}` |
| **Academy JSON protocol** (login, OTP, quizzes, instructors, video OTP) | `{{baseUrl}}/local/academy/api.php?function=…` and `/local/vdocipher/api.php` | `token` | `{"status":"fail","error","errorcode"}`; HTTP **401** only when the token is dead |
| **Plain endpoints** | `getalltopics.php`, `home.php`, `design_system.php`, `certificate.php`, `googleauth/token.php` | varies (see each) | varies |

## Variables (collection → Variables tab)

| Variable | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | Site root **without** trailing slash |
| `regtoken` | Shared *Registration API* token — pre-login calls (sign-up, OTP, login, public content) |
| `wstoken` | The signed-in user's token — filled automatically from the Login response |
| `userid` | Filled automatically by Login / Site info |
| `service` | `moodle_mobile_app` |
| `lang` | `en` or `ar` — sent as `moodlewssettinglang` / `lang` |
| `country` | ISO-2 override for pricing (e.g. `EG`, `SA`) |
| `courseid` `cmid` `categoryid` `transactionid` `subscriptionid` | Sample ids used by the requests |

## Conventions in this collection

- **Read** functions are `GET` with query params; **write** functions are `POST` with an `x-www-form-urlencoded` body. Moodle accepts either for both.
- Optional parameters are present but **unchecked** (disabled) so you can see them without sending them. Tick to send.
- Array parameters use Moodle's form syntax: `fields[0][name]`, `customprofilefields[0][value]`, `courseids[0]`.
- A collection-level test flags Moodle `exception` envelopes and academy `status: fail` envelopes as failed, even though the HTTP status is 200.
- `errorcode: accessexception` means the function is **not in the token's service** — fix on the server with `php local/payments/cli/ws_diagnose.php --token=… --fix`, not in the app.

Source of truth: `public/local/*/db/services.php`, `public/mod/jobform/db/services.php`, `public/local/academy/api.php`, and the guides in `docs/apis/`.

item.name: 01 · Auth & Onboarding
item.description:
Sign-in, registration, forgot-password and Google sign-in. Everything that happens before the app holds a personal `wstoken`.

Pre-login calls use the shared **Registration API token** (`{{regtoken}}`), created by an admin for the `moodle_mobile_app` service. Once signed in, store `data.token` from the login response into `{{wstoken}}` (the collection test script does this for you).

item.name: Login
item.description: Two ways to get a token. Prefer the academy endpoint: it reports a **blocked** account (`errorcode: accountlocked`) where `/login/token.php` only ever says `invalidlogin`.

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=login`** — POST (GET is refused)

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Success → `data.token`, `data.privatetoken` (https only, never for admins), `data.userid`.

`errorcode` values: `invalidlogin`, `accountlocked`, `usernotconfirmed`, `passwordisexpired`, `sitemaintenance`, `servicenotavailable`, `restoredaccountresetpassword`, `postrequired`.

Doc: docs/apis/login-mobile-api.md

urlencoded.description: (required) Username or e-mail address (login-via-email is on).

request.description: Stock Moodle token endpoint, kept for older app builds. Returns `{"token","privatetoken"}` or `{"error","errorcode"}`. A blocked account is reported as plain `invalidlogin`.

Verifies the Google ID token, maps/creates the Moodle account (imports the Google avatar) and returns a web-service token. Errors: `{"error":"<code>"}` with a 4xx status. After this, call **local_profilefields_get_completion_status** — an OAuth account may still owe sign-up fields/consent.

Doc: public/local/googleauth/README.md

urlencoded.description: (required) ID token from native Google Sign-In. `id_token` is accepted as an alias.
(optional) External service shortname, defaults to moodle_mobile_app.

item.name: Site info (who am I / site capabilities)

request.description:
**`core_webservice_get_site_info`** — read

Standard first call after login: user id, full name, picture, site name, language, and the list of functions this token may call (`functions[]`) — useful to confirm the mobile service exposes our `local_*` functions. Sets `{{userid}}`.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

item.name: Registration (sign-up)
item.description:
The site's own sign-up, replacing `auth_email_get_signup_settings` / `auth_email_signup_user`. All four are pre-login and can also be called with no token at all via `/lib/ajax/service-nologin.php`.

Doc: docs/apis/registration-mobile-api.md

request.description:
**`local_profilefields_get_signup_form`** — read · pre-login

The fields to show, in order, with labels, requiredness, options, `minlength`/`maxlength`/`pattern`, plus flow flags: `usernamefromemail`, `countryfromphone`, `ipmatchphone`, `consent{required,label,documents[]}`, `passwordpolicy`, `passwordrules`.

**`local_profilefields_get_policy_documents`** — read · pre-login

The text of the policies shown on sign-up so the app can render them itself.

query.description: (optional) 0 = every sign-up document; or one versionid from consent.documents.

request.description:
**`local_profilefields_signup_user`** — **write** · pre-login

Field-level problems come back in `warnings[]` (not as exceptions). On success the account is created unconfirmed and a confirmation e-mail is sent.

urlencoded.description: (required) 1 = the user ticked the agreement box (required when consent.required).
(required) Custom field entries: type/name/value triplets, indexed.
(required) The field name exactly as get_signup_form gave it.
(optional) Only when get_signup_form lists an email2 field.
(optional) Only when a captcha is configured.
(optional) Local URL to land on after confirmation.

request.description:
**`local_profilefields_resend_confirmation`** — **write** · pre-login

Rate-limited. Always returns `retryafter` (seconds) — drive the button countdown from it. Never reveals whether an address is registered.

item.name: Forgot password (OTP)
item.description:
Three-step e-mail OTP flow on the academy endpoint. All POST, all with the Registration API token.

Doc: docs/apis/forgot-password-mobile-api.md

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=request_password_otp`** — POST (GET is refused)

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Sends a 6-digit code by e-mail. The response never says whether the address exists.

**`/local/academy/api.php?function=verify_password_otp`** — POST (GET is refused)

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Success → `data.resettoken` + `data.expiresin` (seconds).

**`/local/academy/api.php?function=reset_password`** — POST (GET is refused)

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Clears any account lockout as well.

urlencoded.description: (required) Must meet the site password policy.

item.name: OAuth completion (finish a Google sign-up)
item.description:
An account created by Google sign-in was never shown the sign-up form. Ask what is still outstanding, then save it.

Doc: docs/apis/oauth-completion-mobile-api.md

request.description:
**`local_profilefields_get_completion_status`** — read

`complete`, `gateenabled`, `countryfromphone`, `fields[]` (in sign-up order, with `locked`, `options[]`) and `consent{required,label,documents[]}`. If `complete` is true skip the screen.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_profilefields_update_profile`** — **write**

Same call as the profile editor; completion is recorded automatically when nothing is left outstanding.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.
(required) Name exactly as get_completion_status gave it.
(required) Phone = "ISO:number" without dial code; datetime = unix ts; checkbox = "0"/"1".
(optional) Send 1 only when consent.required was true.

item.name: 02 · Site Content (public, no login)
item.description: Branding and static content the app renders before or without a login. These need **no personal token** — the Registration token is used only so the web-service calls go through the mobile service.

request.description:
**`local_profilefields_get_footer`** — read · pre-login

The site footer as data, already resolved to one language.

Doc: docs/apis/footer-mobile-api.md

**`local_profilefields_get_static_pages`** — read · pre-login

Slug, kind, name and web address of every published static page (about, contact, terms, privacy, refund, faq).

**`local_profilefields_get_static_page`** — read · pre-login

Body as HTML, plus contact rows/social links (Contact) or Q&A (FAQ). Legal pages return the mapped tool_policy document.

query.description: (required) about | contact | terms | privacy | refund | faq

request.description:
No auth. Category `id` (join key to core_course_get_categories), localised `name`, recursive `coursecount`, hero `image` URL and `icon` (URL **or a single emoji** or "").

Doc: docs/apis/category-course-details-mobile-api.md §1.2

query.description: (optional) Max rows, clamped 0..50; 0 (the default) = every top-level category, empty ones included.

item.name: Design system (brand colours, category styles, fonts, components)

request.description:
Public, cached 5 min, CORS `*`. `brandcolors.schemes.{light,dark}` says which group the site wears per mode; `brandcolors.groups[].roles[]` carry the 16 role colours; `categorystyles`, `fonts`, `components` mirror the gallery tabs.

Doc: docs/apis/design-system-api.md

Older flat palette feed: `colours{key:hex}` + `tokens[]`. Prefer design_system.php.

Doc: docs/apis/colour-palette-api.md

item.name: 03 · Catalogue & Courses
item.description:
Browsing, searching and opening courses. Prices are resolved per country: profile country → IP country → default row. Pass `country` to override.

Doc: docs/apis/category-course-details-mobile-api.md

request.description:
**`core_course_get_categories`** — read

Core. id, name, parent, path, depth, description, coursecount. Join with the home categories feed for image/icon.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.
(optional) id | ids | name | parent | idnumber | visible | theme

item.name: Courses with pricing (list / by category / by ids)

request.description:
**`local_payments_get_courses_with_pricing`** — read

Course rows in the shape the app's course cards use, each with its country-resolved price, discount/offer and free flag.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.
(optional) id | ids | shortname | idnumber | category. Empty = all courses.
(optional) Filter value; for ids a comma-separated list.

request.description:
**`local_nit_category_search`** — read

Courses and categories counted and paged separately. Course rows match local_payments_get_courses_with_pricing.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.
(optional) full = priced course rows; ids = ids only

request.description:
**`core_course_get_courses_by_field`** — read

Core. Works without enrolment. `overviewfiles[0].fileurl` (+`&token=`) is the cover, `contacts[]` the instructors, `customfields[]` the prerequisites / ILOs / hours / language / certificate / free flags — read `valueraw` for checkbox & number.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_payments_get_course_price`** — read

Resolved price, currency, and any offer/discount for one course.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_payments_get_course_access`** — read

Enrolment + payment status for the course — decides between Buy / Continue / Preview.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=is_course_free`** — GET

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

`{courseid,is_free,price?,currency?,country_required?}`.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=enrol_free_course`** — POST (GET is refused)

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Self-enrols the caller in a course that has no price rows. Fails with `coursenotfree` otherwise.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`core_enrol_get_users_courses`** — read

Core. The "My learning" list; pair with local_payments_get_purchased_courses.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

item.name: Course structure — sections, topics, activities (enrolled only)

request.description: Full course tree for the player screen: course metadata + `parents[]` (sections → topics → activities). Each activity carries `modname`, `mediatype` (video/audio/image/pdf/document/vdocipher), `isvdocipher`, `otpurl`, `fileurl`, playing time and the free-preview flag. Returns `403 nopermissions` when not enrolled — use core_course_get_courses_by_field for the preview screen.

**`core_course_get_contents`** — read

Core equivalent of getalltopics.php without our media/vdocipher enrichment.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

item.name: 04 · Instructors
item.description: Instructor directory and profiles (local_academy JSON protocol).

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=browse_teachers`** — GET

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Directory of instructors with photo, subjects and course count.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=get_teacher`** — GET

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Bio, photo, subjects, courses taught. `errorcode: teachernotfound` when missing.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=get_teacher_courses`** — GET

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Courses this instructor teaches.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=get_all_teachers`** — GET

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Requires `local/academy:manageplatform`. Paged, filterable list for a dashboard app.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

item.name: 05 · Learning (inside a course)
item.description: Playing lessons, taking quizzes, asking the AI assistant and filling Job Forms.

item.name: Secure video (VdoCipher)
item.description:
DRM video: the server mints a short-lived, watermarked OTP per play. Fetch it **at tap time**, never cache it.

Doc: docs/apis/vdocipher-mobile-api.md

request.description:
**`/local/vdocipher/api.php?function=get_playback`** — GET

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Success → `{videoid, otp, playbackInfo, watermark, ttl}` for `EmbedInfo.streaming`. Fail → not enrolled / no access / no video attached.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.
(required) Course module id of the VdoCipher activity (or just GET the activity's `otpurl`).

request.description:
**`local_nit_ai_ask`** — read

Requires `local/nit_ai:use`. Answers from the video transcript around the current position.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.
(required) Course module id of the video.
(optional) Playback position in seconds, -1 if unknown.
(optional) Earlier turns (user | assistant), held by the client.

item.name: Quizzes
item.description: Quiz slice of the local_academy JSON protocol. Images inside questions come as `qfile.php` URLs that already carry the token.

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=get_quizzes`** — GET

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Quizzes visible to the caller, with attempt counts and open/close dates.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.
(optional) 0 = every course the user is in.

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=get_quiz`** — GET

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Settings (time limit, attempts allowed, grade method) + the caller's attempt summary.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.
(required) Course module id of the quiz.

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=start_quiz_attempt`** — POST (GET is refused)

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Creates or resumes an attempt and returns the questions with their answer options.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=save_quiz_answer`** — POST (GET is refused)

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Saves without finishing; call as the learner moves between questions.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=submit_quiz_attempt`** — POST (GET is refused)

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Stores every answer in one call (does not finish the attempt).

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=finish_quiz_attempt`** — POST (GET is refused)

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Grades the attempt and returns the result summary.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=get_quiz_attempt`** — GET

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

A finished attempt with per-question correctness, feedback and grade.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=get_my_quiz_attempts`** — GET

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

History of the caller's attempts on one quiz.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description: Token-authorised file endpoint for images inside question text/options. The app normally receives these URLs ready-made from the quiz calls.

item.name: Job Form (certificate-gated activity)
item.description:
mod_jobform: a form the student may fill in once the course certificate is issued.

Doc: docs/apis/jobform-mobile-api.md

request.description:
**`mod_jobform_get_jobforms_by_courses`** — read

The Job Form activities the student can see, with intro and completion info.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

item.name: Get the form (fields, groups, gate status, saved answers)

request.description:
**`mod_jobform_get_form`** — read

Everything needed to render the form: `groups[]`, `fields[]` (type, options, required, dialcodes for phone), whether the certificate gate is open, and any draft/submission.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`mod_jobform_view_jobform`** — **write**

Triggers the viewed event and view-completion.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`mod_jobform_submit_form`** — **write**

Validates and stores the answers. Field-level errors return in `warnings[]`.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.
(required) Field id from get_form (the `id`, not the fieldid column).
(required) Multi-select = JSON array; checkbox = "1"/"0"; date = unix ts; phone = "EG:1012345678".

item.name: 06 · Certificates
item.description: The learner's own mod_customcert certificates. PDFs are rendered on demand (there is no stored file).

request.description:
**`local_academy_get_my_certificates`** — read

Newest first, with the course each belongs to and the public verification link.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_academy_get_certificate_pdf`** — read

The PDF as base64 plus filename and mimetype.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description: Streams the same PDF as `application/pdf` so the app can hand it to a native viewer or share sheet.

query.description: (required) Course module id of the certificate activity.

item.name: 07 · Payments & Checkout
item.description:
Buying a course through the payment gateway (Fawaterk). Flow: **price → payment methods → create_checkout → open URL / show reference → verify_payment → course access**.

Docs: docs/payments/fawaterk.md · docs/apis/subscriptions-coupons-mobile-guide.md §3.4 (same `payment_data` contract)

request.description:
**`local_payments_get_payment_methods`** — read

Which gateway(s) serve the buyer's country + the course currency.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

item.name: 2 · Gateway payment methods (card, Fawry, Meeza, wallets)

request.description:
**`local_payments_get_provider_payment_methods`** — read

The concrete methods the active gateway offers; pass the chosen `id` as `payment_method_id` to create_checkout.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_payments_create_checkout`** — **write**

Returns `order_id`, `checkout_url` and `payment_data{type: redirect|reference|none, redirect_url?, reference?, reference_expires_at?, qr?}`.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.
(optional) Coupon to apply. The larger of coupon vs. live offer wins — never both.
(optional) 0 = gateway-hosted picker page; otherwise a specific method id.

request.description:
**`local_payments_verify_payment`** — **write**

Confirms with the gateway and enrols on success. Safe to call repeatedly / poll for reference-type payments.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_payments_get_purchased_courses`** — read

Courses the caller has paid for.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_payments_get_transactions`** — read

The Invoices screen in one call: rows, total, filter options, and per row whether an invoice can be printed and a refund still taken.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_payments_get_payment_history`** — read

Older, unfiltered list. Prefer get_transactions.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_payments_get_invoice`** — read

Invoice details and, by default, the PDF as `pdf_base64`.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_payments_get_refund_options`** — read

What refund the buyer can have on this payment (instant within the window, or a staff request after), and what it is worth.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_payments_submit_refund`** — **write**

Refunds immediately when allowed, otherwise files a request.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.
(optional) Required when the request goes to staff.

item.name: 08 · Offers & Coupons
item.description:
Discounts. Offers apply automatically; coupons are typed in. The larger discount wins — never both.

Doc: docs/apis/subscriptions-coupons-mobile-guide.md §3.1–3.2

request.description:
**`local_nit_commerce_get_available_coupons`** — read

Coupons the calling user can redeem now: active, in window, under the site-wide cap and under their own per-student cap. Each row carries usage_limit (all students; 0 = unlimited), user_limit (one student; 0 = unlimited), plus user_usage_count / user_uses_left (null when no per-student cap or a guest). usage_type (once / multiple) no longer exists.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.
(optional) Only coupons scoped to this category branch + site-wide ones; 0 = all.

request.description:
**`local_nit_commerce_preview_discount`** — read

Base price, best offer, coupon result (`coupon_error` when rejected) and final price — without charging.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

item.name: 09 · Subscriptions
item.description:
Plans that unlock a set of courses for a period. Flow: **available plans → preview_discount (optional) → create_subscription_checkout → open URL → poll my_subscriptions**.

Doc: docs/apis/subscriptions-coupons-mobile-guide.md

request.description:
**`local_nit_subscriptions_get_available_subscriptions`** — read

Active plans with price, duration, `seat_options` (B2B) and the courses each unlocks.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.
(optional) Only plans scoped to this category branch; 0 = all.

request.description:
**`local_nit_subscriptions_create_subscription_checkout`** — **write**

Returns `checkout_url` + `payment_data` (same contract as course checkout). Activation happens on gateway callback — poll get_my_subscriptions.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_nit_subscriptions_get_my_active_subscription`** — read

Plan id, days left and whether renewal is due — for the badge on the account screen.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_nit_subscriptions_get_my_subscriptions`** — read

All the caller's subscription purchases, active first.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_nit_subscriptions_get_subscription_payment_history`** — read

Gateway transactions for subscriptions, newest first.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

item.name: 10 · Account & Profile
item.description:
The account screen: navigation, profile pane, security, e-mail change, delete account.

Docs: docs/apis/account-screens-mobile-api.md · docs/apis/profile-mobile-api.md

request.description:
**`local_profilefields_get_account_menu`** — read

The entries, in order, localised, only for installed plugins.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.
(optional) profile | security | mylearning | certificates | invoices | delete

request.description:
**`local_profilefields_get_account_profile`** — read

Fields in their sections with label, value, display value, options and lock, plus the e-mail row and picture control.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_profilefields_get_security`** — read

Whether a password exists here to change (OAuth accounts may not), last change, cost of changing (signs out everywhere), and the password policy.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_profilefields_get_delete_account_info`** — read

Whether this account may delete itself and the warning + confirmation word to show.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_profilefields_get_profile`** — read

Details, the custom fields this viewer may see, and the section/row tree.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_profilefields_get_profile_form`** — read

Fields in order with labels, current values, requiredness, options and which the auth plugin has locked.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_profilefields_get_profile_fields`** — read

Every custom user profile field with its option values (menu fields).

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_profilefields_update_profile`** — **write**

Same capability checks, validation and e-mail-change confirmation as /user/edit.php. Anything left out keeps its value.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.
(required) Name as get_profile_form / get_account_profile gave it. "lang" is also accepted.

item.name: Upload a file to the draft area (step 1 of picture change)

request.description:
**`core_files_upload`** — **write**

Core. Returns `itemid` of the draft area for core_user_update_picture.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`core_user_update_picture`** — **write**

Core. Applies the uploaded draft file as the user picture.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=get_my_profile`** — GET

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Older profile payload used by earlier app builds. Prefer local_profilefields_get_account_profile.

query.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

item.name: Credentials
item.description: Changing the password or e-mail. A password change destroys **every** session and token, including the caller's — expect the next call to return 401 / invalidtoken and go to login.

request.description:
**`local_academy_change_password`** — **write**

Ends every session and token the account holds.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`/local/academy/api.php?function=change_password`** — POST (GET is refused)

Envelope: `{"status":"success","data":…}` or `{"status":"fail","error":"<show>","errorcode":"<branch on>"}`. HTTP 401 only when the token is dead (sign the user out).

Same effect via the JSON protocol.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

request.description:
**`local_profilefields_request_email_change`** — **write**

Nothing changes until the confirmation link sent to the new address is opened.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.
(required) Proves the account is the caller's.

request.description:
**`local_profilefields_delete_account`** — **write**

Anonymises rather than hard-deletes; destroys every token including the caller's.

urlencoded.description: (required) Web-service token of the signed-in user.

exec: // Moodle answers errors with HTTP 200, so inspect the body.
let body = null; try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}
pm.test('No Moodle exception', () => pm.expect(body.exception, body.errorcode + ': ' + body.message).to.be.undefined);
pm.test('No academy fail envelope', () => pm.expect(body.status, body.errorcode + ': ' + body.error).to.not.equal('fail'));
// Capture tokens / ids so the rest of the collection just works.

if (body.status === 'success' && body.data && body.data.token) { pm.collectionVariables.set('wstoken', body.data.token); if (body.data.userid) pm.collectionVariables.set('userid', String(body.data.userid)); }
